data.title: XPeng Sinks 7% as Q2 Miss Overshadows $6.3B Robotics Valuation, NIO Drops 4%, Tesla Slips
data.description: XPeng's robotics unit just attracted Tencent and Alibaba in China's largest embodied AI funding round, yet the stock is tanking anyway as a revenue miss and a conservative outlook raise questions about whether humanoid robots can rescue an EV business under pressure.
data.author: David Moadel
